rule: **Existing tools work.** Type checkers work through `.d.vibe.ts` (VIP-27), and linters, Knip, bundlers and test runners each read `.vibe`.
errorPattern: No loader is configured for "\.vibe" files
reason: esbuild bundles the .ts twin under its literal name. The plugin reads a module id as a URL and drops everything from the first ? (cleanId in src/index.js), so it does not serve the .vibe file and esbuild has no loader for it. When fixed, remove this file and the esbuild clause of literalGap in encoded-imports.property.test.mjs.
